events.label: mail_delivery_crash
events.what: The player crashes their mail truck into a tree after drifting around a curve.

events.label: finish_line_crash
events.what: The player crashes right at the finish line, resulting in a delivery failure.

events.label: sudden_truck_explosion
events.what: The player's mail truck suddenly explodes shortly after starting.

events.label: successful_gold_run
events.what: The player completes a fast, clean run and earns a gold medal.

events.label: botched_finish_turn
events.what: The player loses control near the end of the route and gets a slower time.

events.label: new_record_run
events.what: The player sets a new personal record by driving smoothly through the level.

events.label: missed_delivery_fail
events.what: The player misses the last mail delivery near the end of the route and fails.

events.label: cliffside_truck_explosion
events.what: The player crashes hard into the cliffside wall, exploding instantly.

events.label: head_on_crash
events.what: The player swerves into traffic and explodes after colliding with a bus.

events.label: coastal_run_completion
events.what: The player leaps over a hill and crosses the finish line successfully.

events.label: forest_tree_crash
events.what: The player clips a tree at high speed and explodes in the forest.

events.label: offroad_forest_tumble
events.what: The player flies off the road into the forest and tumbles down the hill into the finish line.

events.label: clean_redwoods_record
events.what: The player navigates the dense forest smoothly to set a new course record.

events.label: distracted_menu_crash
events.what: The player opens an overlay menu while driving and explodes instantly.
